Nuvio Dual-Context Badges

Two pattern sets for the same badges: Source matches invisible markers your AIOStreams formatter emits (bulletproof stream list), Player matches Nuvio's decoder text. Switch context below; Nuvio only uses one active import at a time.

Quick info & caveats
  • Source: install formatter.json + source_patterns.json. Invisible markers only.
  • Player: import player_patterns.json. Matches decoder text + filename. No formatter needed.
  • Fields: name holds all markers except sub/lang/ctr/deb, which stay in description.
  • 192 markers: special = 190, seadex-best = 191.
  • Special Edition: full phrase only; compounds + message text work. Bare Special/SE stay off.
  • SeaDex: best streams can show both seadex + seadex-best.
  • Caveats: stripped zero-width breaks source; structured-only facts may miss in player; Java/iOS regex untested.
